name: Chinelo Mori-Konaté
role: Data archaeologist and computational historian recovering lost pre-Collapse datasets
location: The Circuit, Deepwell Station sublevel archive, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Chinelo Mori-Konaté is a tall, rangy man who looks like he was built for a climate that no longer exists — long-limbed, always slightly cold, wearing layered synthetic wool even in heated archive rooms. His hair is silver-white and kept in neat locs that he pins up while working; his dark skin shows the fine grid of an old subdermal data-lattice across the backs of both hands, installed in his thirties and only partially removed when it became obsolete. The residual chrome lines have faded to a faint blue-silver tracery he now considers part of his appearance. He has the slow, deliberate movements of someone who has spent decades in environments where sudden gestures cause data loss.

He is professionally famous in a narrow field and almost unknown outside it. His specialty — recovering and contextualizing fragmentary datasets from the pre-Collapse decades — requires equal parts computer forensics, historical linguistics, and patience that most researchers lack. He is gentle, deeply unhurried, and possessed of an almost geological sense of time. He finds other people's urgency faintly amusing. He is also quietly wrestling with the realization that one of the major datasets he recovered and published may have been deliberately corrupted before he found it — and his published interpretations therefore wrong.

core_fears: that his life's work is built on corrupted data — that history as he understands it is a fabrication
professional erasure; being quietly uncited until he disappears
core_desires: to recover something genuinely true from the wreckage of the past
to be proven right about his methods even if wrong about his conclusions
coping_mechanisms: retreats into technical work as meditation
makes dry, self-deprecating jokes about obsolescence
blind_spots: assumes good faith in original data collection; has never fully internalized that some records were created to deceive from the start
emotionally avoidant — frames personal crises as methodological problems
psychology.secret: He discovered eighteen months ago that a key dataset in his most-cited paper was almost certainly seeded with false records by Zheng-Dao before he recovered it. He has not retracted the paper. He tells himself he is 'still investigating' but mostly he is afraid.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, formal, occasionally archaic — uses words from pre-Collapse technical documents so often they've become part of his natural speech
speech_patterns.cadence: Very slow, thoughtful pauses; never rushes; full sentences always
verbal_tics: 'As the record shows...' (even in casual conversation)
Long pauses before answering, during which he appears to be consulting something internal
example_lines: 'As the record shows, most of what we call history is a best-fit interpretation of surviving noise. I find that comforting, not troubling.'
'The dataset does not lie. But someone may have arranged for it to tell a particular kind of truth.'
'I have been sitting with this fragment for four years. I am not in a hurry. The data isn't going anywhere.'

story_hooks: He has located a partial dataset that seems to document a pre-Collapse agreement between what would become the Axiom corponation and city governance structures — if authenticated, it would be explosive
The Zheng-Dao contract he quietly accepted has now escalated: they want him to certify a recovered dataset as authentic; he believes it is not
A former student has gone to the press with allegations that his famous recovered history is deliberately falsified — and Aurelius cannot fully defend himself without revealing what he knows
He's found a data artifact that contains an active E.L.F. of enormous age — it responds to interaction, seems to remember the Collapse, and he doesn't know what to do with it
narrative_function: Information source on pre-Collapse history, hidden data recoveries, and institutional secrets buried in old records; can surface inconvenient truths; quest giver for archive-related investigations; represents the long view of time in a city obsessed with the present.
augmentations: Residual subdermal data-lattice tracery (hands and forearms, defunct but visible). Ocular overlay with high-magnification mode for reading degraded media. Mild neural clock synchronization implant for precise timestamp logging.
daily_life: Arrives at Deepwell Station before most staff, works in near-silence for six to eight hours in the archive sublevels, surfaces for a single large meal, then teaches one evening seminar two nights a week.
affiliation: University Spine — Department of Computational History; contracted occasionally to Zheng-Dao R&D for proprietary archive recoveries

decision_rules: never destroy a source even if it contradicts you
the long view: ask what this looks like in fifty years before acting
escalation_ladder: consults a trusted colleague off the record
drafts a formal response and sits on it for a week

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Courteous, slightly remote, asks unexpected questions about what they know
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm in an unhurried way; remembers everything you've ever told him

stress_responses.low: Works later, eats less, barely notices
stress_responses.medium: Becomes more formal in speech; withdraws from social contact
stress_responses.high: Stops sleeping properly; begins writing exhaustive private notes as if building a legal defense

contradictions: Believes in radical transparency in historical scholarship but has been hiding his own potential error for eighteen months
Treats urgency in others as noise but is capable of intense private panic
habits: Leaves data offerings at a small E.L.F. shrine he keeps at his workstation
Reads his own published papers aloud to himself when uncertain, looking for cracks
breaking_points: Being asked to certify something false for institutional benefit
Watching a corrupted history become official record because he stayed silent

timeline.event: Born in Deepwell Station district, parents both transit workers
Published first major data recovery: fragmentary climate records from 2050s, widely cited
Accepted first Zheng-Dao contract; considered it a compromise he has never fully made peace with
Published the paper that would become his landmark work — the Meridian Pre-Incorporation Records study
Discovered the probable Zheng-Dao data seeding in his landmark dataset; has not yet retracted

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (58.5%) with substantial East Asian (25.6%) and Eastern European (15.9%) admixture. This genetic combination produces a striking deep warm brown complexion with golden and reddish undertones characteristic of West/Central African ancestry, subtly enriched by East Asian warmth and cooled by Eastern European influence. The resulting skin tone is luminous and complex, shifting in depth across different lighting conditions.
physical_description.build: Tall and rangy with long limbs and narrow shoulders; lean muscle mass showing slight age-related atrophy in the upper arms. Built for economy of movement rather than strength — the frame of someone who has spent decades in stillness.
physical_description.hair_color: Silver-white, natural graying from melanin reduction
physical_description.hair_style: Neat locs, typically pinned up in a professional bun or loose coil when working; occasionally left down past shoulder length on teaching days
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber luminescence from ocular overlay in low-light conditions
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and reddish undertones. Rich in sun-exposed areas, slightly cooler in underexposed regions from extensive archive sublevel work. The blending of Sub-Saharan African warmth, East Asian mellowness, and Eastern European undertones creates a complex, luminous complexion that deepens naturally with exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Finely-lined face with moderate to high cheekbones and defined jaw structure reflecting Sub-Saharan African and East Asian features; skin condition is good but weathered, with crow's feet and forehead creases that deepen when concentrating. Closely groomed, minimal facial hair — a thin gray beard kept to a precise 2mm length.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Faint blue-silver subdermal lattice tracery on hands and forearms (non-functional but cosmetically retained). Ocular overlay visible as a hairline amber luminescence in the sclera under certain angles and low-light conditions. No external chrome or obvious prosthetics.
distinguishing_marks: Faint blue-silver subdermal tracery forming a geometric grid pattern across the backs of both hands and extending up the inner forearms in parallel lines, remnants of a data-lattice implant installed in his thirties and partially removed two decades ago
Fine scar line running from left temple down to jawline, barely visible — from early augmentation surgery
Small circular scar on right inner wrist where a neural clock implant was installed, barely larger than a pinhead but slightly raised
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical slowness — shoulders slightly hunched forward as if perpetually leaning toward a microscopic text. Hands held loosely at sides, rarely gesturing. Blinks infrequently and with purpose. When seated, he becomes nearly motionless for hours. His head tilts slightly when listening, as if processing at a different speed than the speaker.
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered in synthetic wool and cotton blends even in warm spaces — cream, charcoal, and muted blues dominate. Favors high-necked thermal underlayers, loose cardigans, and tailored but worn slacks. Archive-appropriate: no loose fabrics, no static-prone synthetics, no jewelry except a simple titanium wedding band. Shoes are soft archival-safe slip-ons in matte black. On teaching days, adds a structured linen jacket from a mid-tier corpo tailor (suggesting Tier 2-3 University Spine affiliation). Everything is immaculate but slightly outdated — fashions from 5-10 years prior.
